movelist.name: Metal Sound
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Special Defense lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Discharge
movelist.effect: Discharge Paralyzes all legal targets on 15+.

movelist.name: Screech
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Defense lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Mirror Shot
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Accuracy lowered by -2 on 16+.

movelist.name: Autotomize
movelist.effect: For the remainder of the Encounter, the user’s Weight Class is one value lower, to a minimum of 1. If the user can, the user’s Speed is raised by +2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Charge Beam
movelist.effect: If Charge Beam successfully hits a target, roll 1d20. On a roll of 7+,  the user’s Special Attack is raised by +1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.effect: The Pokémon resists Ground-Type Moves one step further, and gains a Levitate Speed of 4, or has existing Levitate Speeds increased by +2. Defensive.

abilities.name: Plus
abilities.trigger: An ally within 10m has Combat Stages raised
abilities.effect: The target gains an additional Combat Stage in one stat raised by the triggering effect.

abilities.name: Targeting System
abilities.effect: Connection – Lock-On. The user may activate this Ability to use Lock-On as a Swift Action.
